title: `external-secrets.io/v1beta1` is no longer served — manifests must use v1

detection.reason: read from each object's managedFields: the apiVersion every field manager (kubectl, Helm, Argo CD, Flux) last wrote it with — the manifests that will fail to apply

quote: v0.17.0 Stops serving `v1beta1` apis. You need to update your manifests from `v1beta1` to `v1` prior to updating from `v0.16` to `v0.17`.
remediation: Change `apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1` to `external-secrets.io/v1` in the manifests (Git, Helm charts, Kustomize) behind each object named and re-apply them while still on 0.16; after 0.17 an apply in v1beta1 fails with 'no matches for kind'.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.metadata.managedFields[]?; .apiVersion == "external-secrets.io/v1beta1")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) managers=\([.metadata.managedFields[] | select(.apiVersion == "external-secrets.io/v1beta1") | .manager] | unique | join(","))"'  # each row was last written as v1beta1 by the managers listed
coversNotes: v0.17.0 (What's Changed): chore: unserve v1beta1 and mark it as deprecated
CRD clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io: version v1beta1 no longer served
CRD clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io: version v1beta1 no longer served
CRD externalsecrets.external-secrets.io: version v1beta1 no longer served
CRD secretstores.external-secrets.io: version v1beta1 no longer served
